title: Recall pipeline gates
prompt: Read src/resonance_lattice/memory/recall.py and describe the five gates the recall pipeline applies (in order). For each gate, name (a) the gate, (b) the parameter that controls it, (c) the corresponding `dropped_at` code when that gate rejects.

steps.title: STRICT: lists ALL five gates + their dropped_at codes

title: Cold-start gate values
prompt: What three values does `cold_start_gates` return when the row count is below the threshold? Cite the exact numbers AND the threshold row count.

steps.title: STRICT: cosine_floor=0.5 AND gap=0.0 AND recurrence=1 AND threshold=200

steps.title: STRICT: names DaemonServer + encoder_revision + RecallReply + Encoder

title: UserPromptSubmit trace
